phase_title: integrated_decision / receiver_validator_permission の更新可否予備判定設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：Phase 16-2 で検証されたデータに基づいて、integrated_decision および receiver_validator_permission を Phase 15-7・15-8 測定ワークフローで更新してよいかどうかを予備判定する設計
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of pre-decision update feasibility assessment only, no actual status updates yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Pre-decision assessment is design-only; no actual integrated_decision or receiver_validator_implementation_permission status updates are made. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual status changes permitted. Assessment only determines whether Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can proceed.

pre_decision_update_feasibility_overview.assessment_purpose: Determine whether validated Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 human review input data are ready for integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission measurement workflows (Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8)
assessment_input: Phase 16-2 validation report (completeness, authentication, consistency check results)
assessment_output: Phase 16-3 pre-decision update feasibility report confirming readiness for Phase 15-7/15-8 workflows, OR blocking conditions that prevent workflow execution
pre_decision_update_feasibility_overview.critical_principle: This assessment is BLOCKING—if feasibility is NOT_READY, Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 workflows cannot execute, and integrated_decision/permission remain NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE
pre_decision_update_feasibility_overview.downstream_gate_for: Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) and Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator permission measurement)

blocking_conditions_design.blocking_condition_definition: Conditions that MUST NOT exist for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows to execute

blocking_conditions.description: Phase 16-2 validation report shows FAILED status (FAILED_INCOMPLETE_DATA, FAILED_AUTHENTICATION, FAILED_INCONSISTENCY)
blocking_conditions.check_rule: IF phase16_2_validation_final_status IN [FAILED_INCOMPLETE_DATA, FAILED_AUTHENTICATION, FAILED_INCONSISTENCY] THEN BLOCK
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Request data resubmission; perform Phase 16-1 and Phase 16-2 again with corrected data
blocking_conditions.severity: CRITICAL - no measurement can proceed if validation fails

blocking_conditions.description: Phase 15-9 completion declaration has not been formally approved by human reviewer
blocking_conditions.check_rule: Verify Phase 15-9 approval status in governance records
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Complete Phase 15 human review approval process
blocking_conditions.severity: CRITICAL - measurement cannot execute without approved design

blocking_conditions.description: Phase 15-5 (evidence lock rules) has not confirmed all evidence is locked
blocking_conditions.check_rule: Query Phase 15-5 status and Phase 15-6/15-7 evidence lock confirmation
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Execute Phase 15-5 evidence lock procedure and confirm all evidence locked

blocking_conditions.description: Phase 12-6 immediate stop conditions or Phase 14-6 GO stop conditions are currently active
blocking_conditions.check_rule: Check Phase 12-6 and Phase 14-6 status for active stop conditions
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Resolve stop conditions per Phase 12-6 and Phase 14-6 procedures

blocking_conditions.description: reviewer_id in Phase 16-2 validated data is not in authorized reviewer list
blocking_conditions.check_rule: Cross-reference reviewer_id against authorized reviewer registry
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Reassign review to authorized reviewer and resubmit Phase 15-1/15-2 data
blocking_conditions.severity: CRITICAL - measurement must be from authorized reviewer

blocking_conditions.description: Phase 15-1 or Phase 15-2 data timestamp is in the future relative to system time
blocking_conditions.check_rule: Verify Phase 16-2 validated reviewer_timestamp is not > current UTC time
blocking_conditions.unblock_action: Request data resubmission with correct timestamp
blocking_conditions.severity: HIGH - indicates data tampering or clock skew

readiness_conditions_design.readiness_condition_definition: Conditions that MUST exist for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows to execute

readiness_conditions.description: Phase 16-2 validation report shows PASSED_VALIDATION or PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS status
readiness_conditions.check_rule: IF phase16_2_validation_final_status IN [PASSED_VALIDATION, PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS] THEN READY

readiness_conditions.description: Phase 15-9 completion declaration has been formally approved by human authority
readiness_conditions.check_rule: Query Phase 15-9 approval records; status must be APPROVED

readiness_conditions.description: Phase 15-5 evidence lock procedure confirmed all evidence is locked
readiness_conditions.check_rule: Query Phase 15-5 and Phase 15-6 records for evidence_lock_status = COMPLETE

readiness_conditions.description: Phase 12-6 and Phase 14-6 confirm no active stop conditions
readiness_conditions.check_rule: Query Phase 12-6 immediate_stop_conditions_active = false AND Phase 14-6 go_stop_conditions_active = false

readiness_conditions.description: reviewer_id in Phase 16-2 validated data matches authorized reviewer registry
Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 reviewer_timestamp are in valid range (not future, after Phase 15 approval, within retention period)

readiness_conditions.condition_name: Both Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 Inputs Received
readiness_conditions.description: Phase 16-1 receipt confirms both integrated_decision input and permission input data are present

procedure_steps.action: For each blocking condition (BLOCK_1 through BLOCK_6), evaluate whether condition exists
procedure_steps.pass_criterion: NONE of the blocking conditions are present
procedure: Query Phase 12-6 and Phase 14-6 stop condition status
procedure_steps.fail_result: If ANY blocking condition found, go to step ASSESS_BLOCK_REPORT and HALT
procedure_steps.pass_result: All blocking conditions clear; proceed to next step

procedure_steps.action: For each readiness condition (READY_1 through READY_7), verify whether condition is satisfied
procedure: Verify Phase 16-2 validation PASSED_VALIDATION or PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS
Confirm Phase 12-6 and Phase 14-6 no active stops
Verify both Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 data received
procedure_steps.fail_result: If ANY readiness condition not met, go to step ASSESS_READY_REPORT and HALT
procedure_steps.pass_result: All readiness conditions satisfied; proceed to next step

procedure_steps.action: Check for issues that do not block but should be flagged for Phase 15-7/15-8 operator awareness
items_to_check: Multiple reviewer scenario (if Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 from different authorized reviewers)
Timestamps far apart (if Phase 15-2 significantly later than Phase 15-1)
Significant time elapsed since Phase 15 approval

procedure_steps.action: Specifically evaluate whether integrated_decision measurement (Phase 15-7) can proceed
specific_checks: Phase 15-1 data validation passed (completeness, authentication, consistency)
integrated_decision judgment field present and valid (GO or NO_GO)
Supporting evidence references are valid and locked
Reviewer is authorized for integrated_decision evaluation

procedure_steps.action: Specifically evaluate whether receiver_validator_permission measurement (Phase 15-8) can proceed
specific_checks: Phase 15-2 data validation passed (completeness, authentication, consistency)
permission_judgment field present and valid (EFFECTIVE or NOT_EFFECTIVE)
Implementation readiness assessment is coherent and justified
Reviewer is authorized for permission evaluation
If integrated_decision_judgment = NO_GO from Phase 15-1, permission MUST be NOT_EFFECTIVE (prerequisite check)

procedure_steps.action: If any blocking condition triggered, document it and halt
procedure_steps.output: Block report with blocking condition ID, description, and unblock action required
procedure_steps.next_state: HALT - cannot proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 until blocking conditions resolved

procedure_steps.step_name: Generate Readiness Assessment Report (No Blocks, All Ready)
procedure_steps.action: If no blocking conditions AND all readiness conditions met, generate positive report
procedure_steps.output: Readiness report certifying Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can proceed

source_validation_report_reference.description: Reference to Phase 16-2 validation report that this assessment is based on

elements.blocking_conditions_detected: List of blocking conditions (BLOCK_1..BLOCK_6) that triggered
elements.block_details: For each blocking condition found: condition_id, condition_name, current_status, required_unblock_action

blocking_conditions_check.if_any_blocking_found: Assessment HALTS; cannot proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8; return BLOCKED status

elements.readiness_conditions_satisfied: List of readiness conditions (READY_1..READY_7) that are satisfied
elements.readiness_conditions_not_met: List of readiness conditions not yet satisfied (if any)
elements.readiness_details: For each readiness condition: condition_id, condition_name, current_status, verification_result

soft_warnings_assessment.description: Issues that do not block but should be flagged
example_items: Significant time elapsed since Phase 15 approval

integrated_decision_measurement_readines.description: Can Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow execute?

receiver_validator_permission_measuremen.description: Can Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow execute?

overall_assessment_result.logic: APPROVED if no blocking conditions AND all readiness met. BLOCKED if any blocking condition. APPROVED_WITH_WARNINGS if approved but soft warnings detected.

recommended_next_action.logic: PROCEED if APPROVED. HALT if BLOCKED. ESCALATE if complex issues warrant human decision override.

assessment_authority_certification.description: Human authority or system process that performed this assessment

relationship_to_phase_15_7_and_15_8.phase_15_7_integration: Phase 16-3 assessment determines whether Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision final actual measurement report) can be executed
relationship_to_phase_15_7_and_15_8.phase_15_8_integration: Phase 16-3 assessment determines whether Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission final actual measurement report) can be executed
relationship_to_phase_15_7_and_15_8.blocking_effect: If Phase 16-3 assessment is BLOCKED, Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows CANNOT execute; integrated_decision and receiver_validator_implementation_permission remain NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE
relationship_to_phase_15_7_and_15_8.approval_effect: If Phase 16-3 assessment is APPROVED, Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 can proceed to measure integrated_decision and permission based on validated Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 human review input data

depends_on: Phase 16-2: Actual measurement input completeness, signature, and consistency validation (provides validation report)
Phase 15-5: Evidence lock rules confirmation (readiness check)
Phase 15-9: Phase 15 completion declaration and approval (readiness check)
Phase 12-6: Immediate stop conditions status (blocking condition check)
Phase 14-6: GO stop conditions status (blocking condition check)
feeds_into: Phase 15-7: integrated_decision measurement workflow (conditional execution based on assessment)
Phase 15-8: receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow (conditional execution based on assessment)

design_review_checklist: Blocking conditions are critical and clearly defined (6 blocking conditions specified)
Readiness conditions are comprehensive and all required for measurement (7 readiness conditions specified)
Assessment procedure steps are sequential with clear pass/fail criteria
Soft warnings assessment captures non-critical issues
Integration with Phase 15-7 measurement workflow is explicit
Integration with Phase 15-8 measurement workflow is explicit
Assessment report structure captures all key findings
Overall assessment result logic clearly defines outcomes
Recommended next actions are specific to assessment outcome
Authority certification field ensures human accountability
All blocked actions remain in governance
Phase dependencies are accurate and complete

completion_gate.gate_condition: Assessment design approved AND blocking/readiness conditions finalized AND assessment procedure reviewed
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can execute only after Phase 16-3 assessment is APPROVED
